tasks.analysis: Water is essential for life as we know it, so finding water on other planets and moons is a crucial part of the quest to find life beyond Earth. Mars’ riverbeds show evidence of water in ancient times.The moons Europa and Enceladus have ice-covered surfaces that may hide oceans beneath. Discovering new extraterrestrial water, whether past or present, liquid or solid, could significantly impact our understanding of life in the universe.
